Class Term

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.layout.cassowary.Term
public final class Term extends Object
A term in a linear expression, representing a coefficient multiplied by a variable.

Terms are the building blocks of linear expressions. A term consists of a variable and a coefficient, representing the product coefficient * variable.

This implementation uses Fraction for exact arithmetic, avoiding the cumulative rounding errors that occur with floating-point.
